Trinidade) 178773 Co-op Position Toronto, ON Canada 12 months Hybrid CAD 55000.0 per year for 35 Major List 55000-65000 Job title: Co-Op Student - Data and AI Strategy • Entity: Sanofi Vaccines Canada Ltd. Location: AI CENTRE of EXCELLENCE (Digital Data Hub) 240 Richmond Street West, Toronto, ON, Canada • <Hybrid> Duration: 12 months: May 2026 - April 2027 • Note: Candidates must be available 35 hours per week, Monday-Friday About the job Looking to launch your career at the cutting edge of healthcare? Join Sanofi for a chance to develop with mentoring and guidance from inspirational leaders while helping to make an impact on the lives of countless people worldwide. As Co-Op Student -Data and AI Strategy in our Corporate Functions, the role includes translating business strategy into digital, technology, AI and ways of working strategies, driving the business forward. Sanofi has recently embarked into a vast and ambitious digital transformation program. The Digital Data team at Sanofi Canada is the innovation engine that enables the digital transformation of the company globally. We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. We're also a company where you can flourish and grow your career, with countless opportunities to explore, make connections with people, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible. Ready to get started? Main responsibilities: • Support strategic Data & AI programs with cross functional teams, ensuring we build the right products, with scalable data foundations that deliver AI capabilities. • Participate in key Data & AI strategy development, strategic frameworks & strategic initiatives that deliver on evolving topics allowing Sanofi to go all in on AI, responsibly. • Assist with PMO function for an AI portfolio that includes regular reviews, and use of the standard tools to help coordinate on time delivery, value, scope, and program finances. • Help curate and enable Storytelling & Analytics to create communications for executives, digital teams and the average Sanofi-an that delivered our "value delivered" story. • Support the development of key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure the investment, success and impact of data and AI initiatives. • Aid digital team members to maintain strong relationships with key tech and consulting partners, ensuring value add and co- development. • Contribute to ad-hoc strategic initiatives of the Digital Data organization, in a support capacity in collaboration with the Strategy arm of the team. Why choose us? • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team. • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it's through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally. • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact. This position is for a current vacant role that we are actively hiring for. "Artificial Intelligence" refers to any systems that use automated processes, including algorithms and machine learning, to analyze data and make predictions, inferences, decisions, or recommendations without direct human involvement. These systems may process personal information to identify patterns, improve services, or support decision-making. The Company may use Artificial Intelligence for purposes including, but not limited to, resume screening and hiring, scheduling interviews or meetings, conducting surveys, matching skills with potential job openings, interview scoring, ensuring compliance with regulations applicable to our industry, and activities related to performance evaluation. Information collected and processed by the Company's Artificial Intelligence systems may include the personal information detailed above and calendar availability. It excludes the information collected and processed for monitoring purposes. You should contact Human Resources if you have a question or concern regarding your personal information. You can also contact Canada's Privacy Officer via Sanofi's data subject request portal, Data Subject Rights Webform. The Data Subject Rights Webform can also be used to request access or correction of your personal information and file a complaint. Job Requirements About you • Must be currently enrolled as a student at an accredited university, in an accredited Co-Op program and have completed at least one year of study. • Education: Working towards a degree Bachelors or Masters in the fields of Sciences or Engineering or Business or Digital or Data science. (Preferred - MMAI, Mbiotech, MBM, MBDC and related programs) • Minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale or 8.0 on a 12.0 scale • Technical skills: Proficient in use of MS Office, including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word • Exposure to end-to-end strategy-to-implementation digital / data & AI consulting, with eagerness to learn across the full lifecycle. • Ability to act as a translator, gathering business needs, pain points, requirements and overall strategy to design the right data and AI solutions, simplify complex jargon and set the tone for a positive change culture. • Coursework or exposure to techno-functional capabilities (e.g. data engineering, data science, architecture, cloud, data visualization, AI Implementations, data governance risk management and more). • Eagerness to solve problems & identify opportunities for programs, processes & products. Effective written communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. • Experience working on Data & AI orientated projects & Business case studies Strong problem solving, critical thinking and analytical skills along with ability to deal with ambiguity and work collaboratively with guidance and mentorship. • Exposure to or coursework in Product Innovation & Agile methodologies.
